## Checklist

- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Tests pass with coverage floor met (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] E2E tests pass where relevant (`npm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry added under `Unreleased` for user-visible changes
- [ ] ADR created or updated for design decisions
- [ ] Issue references included in commit message
